About.label: About
About.heading: About Me
About.bio: Frontend Engineer specializing in React, Next.js, and TypeScript for customer-facing web applications. At Candescent, built reusable UI components and shared libraries for digital banking products. At Bezimeni IT, led the frontend architecture of a UK sports streaming platform and technically mentored two frontend engineers.

Experience.candescent_1: Implemented customer-facing features and secure financial workflows, including account management and transactions.
Experience.candescent_2: Built reusable UI components and shared libraries with Material-UI to improve consistency across product features.
Experience.candescent_3: Integrated REST APIs and collaborated closely with backend engineers on feature delivery.
Experience.smsparking_0: Developed a web and mobile parking payment platform for the Dutch market, enabling users to find zones and pay digitally.
Experience.smsparking_1: Built features for zone-based parking, location services, and payment flows across React and Flutter applications.
Experience.bezimeni_0: Made technical decisions and led the frontend architecture for a UK sports streaming platform.
Experience.bezimeni_1: Led and technically mentored two frontend engineers through architecture guidance and code reviews.
Experience.bezimeni_2: Built responsive interfaces for browsing, filtering, and viewing video content with reusable media playback components.
Experience.itengine_0: Developed features for a personalized news feed, topic and content selection, and video content; performed refactoring and maintenance.
Experience.itengine_1: Developed an application for tracking production and procurement processes.
Experience.pricebee_0: Developed frontend functionality for dynamic pricing and interactive data visualizations for a pricing-management platform.
Experience.pricebee_1: Actively participated in the JavaScript-to-TypeScript migration, including typing and code-quality standards.
Experience.vegait_0: Developed a new fintech application and maintained an existing platform, delivering features, reusable UI components, and animations.
Experience.vegait_1: Integrated frontend flows with GraphQL; worked on payment cards, transaction history, cashback, and Contentful-managed content.

Projects.label: Projects

Projects.pricebee: Developed a pricing management platform with dynamic pricing algorithms, interactive data visualizations, and TypeScript migration.

Projects.production: Developed an application for tracking production and procurement processes.
